for_tools.title: How to build an AI that can answer questions about your website - Tutorial
for_tools.text:
For anyone coming to this later, I’d treat this less like “scrape a website and fine-tune the model” and more like a basic RAG setup.

The usual flow is:

>collect website content
>clean it into plain text
>split it into chunks
>create embeddings
>store chunks in a vector store
>on each user question, retrieve the most relevant chunks
>send those chunks + the question to the model

That way the model is not permanently trained on the website. It just gets the right page content at answer time.
